popCulture.title: Metamorphoses
popCulture.creator: Ovid
popCulture.description: Ovid pauses the wedding feast so Perseus can tell the Gorgon's story — the inset that became the Medusa digression of Western art.

popCulture.title: Perseus
popCulture.description: The hero at Andromeda's feast, Gorgon's head still a weapon — narrative as the pause before Phineus' brawl.
